text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Conquering both the Yasuda Kinen and the Sprinters Stakes, Yamanin Zephyr demonstrated unshakable strength across the mile and sprint divisions—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And on top of that, conquering even the Tenno Sho (Autumn),
becoming a true wind that defied even the barrier of distance."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "With a burning soul stronger and more dedicated than anyone else, Yamanin Zephyr made her dream come true..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As her Trainer, I really want to find a way
to express my admiration to her.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, when I asked if she had any requests—

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Praise... you say? Fufu, from my perspective,
that feels more like a blessed breeze that ought to be gifted to you, Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"I gladly accept this triumph.
...Though, I have but one request."

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Would you keep me company on our next day off?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And on a day off,
after meeting Yamanin Zephyr at the school gate,
she took me to—

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... The rustle of wind through the leaves.
Can you hear it too, Trainer?
choice_data_list: Ah... It really is a comfortable place.
Yeah... it's such a comfortable place.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: If it pleases you, then that is an auspicious blessing.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: "However, today, I didn't come just to catch the breeze."

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Shall we go, Trainer?
...Come on!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Yamanin Zephyr, smiling softly with unusual excitement, takes my hand. Her fingers clasp mine quickly and firmly, gentle yet strong.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And just like that—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—She's making me run with all my might!
She's probably holding back a lot, but as for me, I'm sprinting flat out!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, more.
More freely, faster—faster!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I quickly run out of breath.
It becomes difficult to keep my eyes open.
Yamanin Zephyr's smiling face slips behind my eyelids.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: More. Hehe—more!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yet, all the way to the end, I could clearly tell
how terribly warm her fingertips were as she frolicked.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Phew...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Unlike her, who hadn't broken a single sweat and caught
her breath in an instant, I was pathetically
battered and exhausted from head to toe."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Even so, however――

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: "...Do you understand what I mean, Trainer?"

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
No, it's fine even if you don't understand.
Even if we can never be entirely the same.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I only ask that you remember this:
everything you just felt with your entire body.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Please remember this, Trainer.
That is the wind. The true wind.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Faster than anything.
Freer than anything.
And something that can run on endlessly.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"That is the wind.
...The thing I yearned for more than anything."

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: And it is the wind created alongside you.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Please, remember this, okay?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even if I'm gasping for breath.
Even if my head is spinning a little.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I answered Yamanin Zephyr's question with the warmest smile I could muster.
